result_summary.title: Data Export latency issues affecting downstream reports
result_summary.description:
We are experiencing significant delays when triggering data exports from the production environment in US-East. The initial export jobs seem to start fine, but the completion times have increased from under 5 minutes to over 45 minutes. This is impacting about 39 users who rely on these files for their daily operations.

I'm not sure if the bottleneck is occurring during the actual export generation or if the data is sitting somewhere waiting to be written to the warehouse, but the end result is that our downstream reports are stale. The UI doesn't show any errors, just a spinning loading indicator for a very long time. Could you please investigate why the throughput has dropped?
